description: Change server settings at runtime, without a restart. Requires admin role. Each change is audited (server.settings.update) with its value before and after.

main.description: All or nothing: one invalid value or combination refuses the whole request and nothing is saved. Turning a feature off applies to new actions only (existing pen names, accounts in a custody mode no longer offered, devices already signing keep working). Other instances apply the change within refreshSeconds.

changes.description: An object mapping setting ids (see getServerSettings) to new values, or to null to drop the admin's change and return to the setup wizard's choice or the default. Values: pseudonymsEnabled, deviceSigningAllowed, inviteRequired are booleans; pseudonymTokensPerEpoch (1-1000), pseudonymProbationDays (0-365), pseudonymProbationDailyWrites (1-100000) are integers; custodyAllowed is a non-empty list of custodial, assisted, self; custodyDefault one of those; emailVerificationPolicy one of off, advisory, require-for-write, require-for-login; migrationAccounts and migrationCommunities one of open, invite, closed; migrationPseudonyms one of open, token, closed; federationPeers a list of up to 50 https addresses; accountApproval one of manual, automatic; defaultAppearance one of pds-basic, openfederation, opennewsrooms.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: No changes, or a setting that does not exist.

errors.name: InvalidSetting
errors.description: A value is not valid for its setting; `setting` names it.

errors.name: InvalidCombination
errors.description: The settings would contradict each other, for example the way offered first is not offered, or device signing without Self or Assisted.

errors.name: SettingFixedByEnvironment
errors.description: The server's environment sets this setting; change it there and restart.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not an admin.

reset.description: True when the admin's change was dropped.
